regressions.source: SUsds.permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, bytes signature): require(_isValidSignature(owner, digest, signature), 'SUsds/invalid-permit'); allowance[owner][spender] = value; emit Approval(owner, spender, value)
regressions.issue: After the join on return_data.size, the two reads of mem[64] around 'mem[mem[64]] = amount' (_62 and the log's mem[64]) are no longer unified. So the Approval value prints as raw memory instead of 'amount', and the 'SUsds/invalid-permit' revert is raw memory (the other 3 copies of that revert are still decoded).
regressions.rule: Keep the constant floor of mem[64] through the join (here at least 225). A store at mem[64] + k (k >= 0) then cannot touch slot 64, and a later load of mem[64] returns the earlier value.

improvements: P1 2 -> 0 (the Initializable slot prints as one constant) and P6 1 -> 0.
